## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
The package includes a certification that an independent, disinterested party reproduced all results (or specified tables and figures) from the package, e.g. a signed letter by the reproducer or a certificate from a certification agency, stating what was reproduced and how.
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
A certification is provided, but it covers only some of the results, does not state what was reproduced, or comes from a party that is not independent of the authors.
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
No third-party certification is provided when the data are confidential and the reproducer cannot access them.
:::

[Based on: [#131](../../sources.qmd#p131 "Guide for Accelerating Computational Reproducibility in the Social Sciences") only (ACRE, adjusting levels for confidential/proprietary data); see also [#52](../../sources.qmd#p52 "CODECHECK: an open science initiative for the independent execution of computations underlying research articles during peer review to improve reproducibility") CODECHECK certificate, [#56](../../sources.qmd#p56 "Reproducibility badging and definitions") ROR-R badge.]{.source-note}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
C2 (all data in package)
:::
